full_page.content:
Page 20 Cont.
Jan. 20 Mrs. Frances Crawford of Wyonona, Minn. - 44 - began to lose her sight four yrs ago - here To-day blind. Enrolled perpetually.
Ruth Koehler - 30 - Goitre operation.
Antin Dieyon - 39 - heart
Pvt. Fc. Robert Wheeler - 24 - fighting the Japs in Southerin Pacific - was nearly killed - 96 hours unconscious; now honorably discharged - luckily is able to take back his old position but sad to say, instead of appreciation for having risked his life, he meet with resentment in part of fellow workers.
Page 21 Jan. 25 Lt. Robert Mason - 27 - Temple, Texas - wounded Nov. 26 in France; lost one foot .. very slow in healing - fears further amputation. En- rolled Today by phone.
Judith Ann ( Krausman) Rakocy - 2'2 - to be deaf not able to talk at all.
Joan Carole Withey - 2 2 - so called "horsshoe Kidney" and malignant tumor threatening .... Enrolled To-night.
28 Robert Beuer - 37 - fears blindness - Dr's say "Nothing can be done." Enrolled again To-day
E'd Morell - 44 - peculiar trouble with back of neck causing head- aches. Dr's say "top vertebra is growing into skull". at sea what to do or think. Enrolled To-D. 5.00
Alvin Kurcab - 3 - very peculiar sickness in Providence .... Only one case known before in Michigan .... Enrolled To-night. Dr's say only miracle can avail. Father away from sacraments for years; promises to go back.
Page 22 Jan. 29 Joseph Moorsland - middle-aged - of Kalamazoo - auto accident - en- rolled % phone at 9:20 p.m. feared dying.
Mrs. Bern. Allen - 56 - kidney and nerve trouble
Linda Anne Yuhas - 2'2 - Dr's say she has lymphatic lukemia, was here in last November and then was given 3 mos. now ... April 12 here To-day lively and normal ..... Deo Gr.
